source: CAMELS first-generation Subfind catalogues (Villaescusa-Navarro et al. 2021, ApJ 915, 71), cosmic-variance set CV
about: Measured conversions between definitions in the CAMELS fiducial (cosmic-variance) simulations of four codes, 27 seeds each, 25 Mpc/h boxes. Each conversion is the change in log10 of a quantity when its definition changes, as a function of the log10 stellar mass (or M200crit) of the galaxy; median and 16th to 84th percentile of the pooled galaxies, and the standard error of the median across the 27 seeds. Galaxies with a zero value in either definition are left out and counted separately. These describe these codes at this resolution and volume; they are not corrections for other simulations.
